analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($926.73) vs SMA5 ($955.83)/SMA20 ($996.22)/SMA50 ($1035.47) — Below short/mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· Position vs SMA100 ($1023.86)/SMA200 ($871.27) — Long-term trend weakening, support expected above SMA200.
· 52-week position (59.6%) + current price level is historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (47.0→37.3) — Continues in oversold territory, maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (6.5098→-8.8973) — Bearish crossover and worsening, continuing decline post-death cross.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $909.85) — Approaching lower band, increasing oversold pressure.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($897.68) — Based on 20-day low, key defense line on decline.
· Swing Resistance ($948.38) — Based on 5-day high and Pivot R1, short-term bounce expected on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low formation) — Lower lows are rising, but trend reversal is uncertain.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.91x) — Normal level, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Downtrend) — RSI remains oversold and MACD shows bearish signals, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가 923.57이 20일 저가 897.68보다 높아 Higher Low 패턴 형성 중. 그러나 RSI 과매도 지속 및 MACD 약세 신호로 추세 전환 불확실.
